e.summary_hk: 首個面向銀行/金融/保險 AI 護欄的對抗基準：覆蓋 RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/DPDP/歐盟 AI 法案/FATF/BCBS
e.body: FinProof Bench（Zytra，HuggingFace，2026-05-09 创建，CC-BY-4.0，截至核实 601 次下载 / 11 赞）自我定位为「**首个面向银行、金融服务与保险（BFSI）AI 护栏的对抗性基准**」，监管框架覆盖 **RBI（印度央行）· SEBI（印度证券交易委员会）· IRDAI（印度保险监管局）· DPDP（印度数据保护法）· 欧盟 AI 法案 · FATF · BCBS · IEEE 7010**；标注方式为**专家生成 + 机器生成**混合，语言含 en / hi / te / ta（英 / 印地 / 泰卢固 / 泰米尔），卡片说明公开层 T1 含 1,228 行、规模区间 1K–10K。对 RIAA：这是**「监管合规 → 对抗测试」这一环的现成基准**。池内已收 AI 治理类条目（[[insurance-governance]] 与各国监管口径 [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）以及评测类条目（[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]] 红队、[[ins-actbench]]、[[ins-mmbench]]），但**把「具体监管条款」直接做成对抗测试集，这是第一条**——它回答的是「模型在真实监管红线上的表现如何」而非「模型会不会做精算题」；多语言 + 南亚监管框架也提示了区域合规测试的思路。⚠️ 核实说明：HuggingFace 数据集页显示**访问受限（需登录/授权）**，卡片虽提到 T1 公开层，但本词条**未实际下载数据**，仅核实其卡片描述与元数据。
e.body_en: FinProof Bench (Zytra, HuggingFace, created 2026-05-09, CC-BY-4.0, 601 downloads and 11 likes at verification) describes itself as "**the first adversarial benchmark for AI guardrails in Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI)**", covering the regulatory frameworks of **RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, DPDP, the EU AI Act, FATF, BCBS and IEEE 7010**; annotations are **expert-generated plus machine-generated**, with languages en / hi / te / ta, and the card states a public T1 tier of 1,228 rows within the 1K–10K size band. For RIAA: a ready-made benchmark for the **"regulatory compliance → adversarial testing"** stage. This corpus already holds AI-governance entries ([[insurance-governance]] and national regulatory positions [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]], [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[naic-ai-oversight]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]) and evaluation entries ([[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[garak]] red-teaming, [[ins-actbench]], [[ins-mmbench]]), but **this is the first to turn specific regulatory provisions directly into an adversarial test set** — it answers "how does a model perform against real regulatory red lines" rather than "can it do actuarial maths"; its multilingual, South-Asian regulatory framing also suggests a template for regional compliance testing. ⚠️ Verification note: the HuggingFace dataset page shows **restricted access (login/authorisation required)**; although the card mentions a public T1 tier, this entry **did not download the data** and verifies only the card description and metadata.
e.body_hk: FinProof Bench（Zytra，HuggingFace，2026-05-09 創建，CC-BY-4.0，截至核實 601 次下載 / 11 讚）自我定位為「**首個面向銀行、金融服務與保險（BFSI）AI 護欄的對抗性基準**」，監管框架覆蓋 **RBI · SEBI · IRDAI · DPDP · 歐盟 AI 法案 · FATF · BCBS · IEEE 7010**；標註為**專家生成 + 機器生成**混合，語言含 en / hi / te / ta，卡片說明公開層 T1 含 1,228 行。對 RIAA：這是**「監管合規 → 對抗測試」這一環的現成基準**。池內已收 AI 治理類條目（[[insurance-governance]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）與評測類條目（[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]]、[[ins-actbench]]、[[ins-mmbench]]），但**把「具體監管條款」直接做成對抗測試集，這是第一條**。⚠️ 核實說明：HuggingFace 數據集頁顯示**訪問受限**，本詞條**未實際下載數據**，僅核實卡片描述與元數據。
e.verified_note: HuggingFace 官方 API + 数据集卡核实（首个 BFSI AI 护栏对抗基准；RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/DPDP/EU AI Act/FATF/BCBS/IEEE 7010；expert+machine generated；en/hi/te/ta；T1 公开层 1,228 行；创建 2026-05-09、下载 601/赞 11）；页面显示访问受限，未下载数据
